research_method: Selected fixed-ref documents and implementation files; SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 recomputed from exact UTF-8 contents. All 46 Git blobs matched. Upstream software was not executed.
research_limit: This manifest covers 46 selected complete files, not every source path referenced by the feature matrix. Other fixed-ref evidence is graded separately in that matrix; no upstream end-to-end qualification is claimed.

independent_implementations.differences: Pure, read-only pinned-source descriptors and evidence assessment. No T3 server, transport, execution, credential or client-runtime implementation is imported. Vendor evidence is pinned separately in the D01 contract.

distribution: No T3 runtime dependency or source-code port is included in this batch. The copyright and complete MIT text are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and the repository license copy. T3 branding, icons, hosted identity, telemetry and cloud infrastructure are not imported.

feature_matrix_path_evidence.scope: Path existence from cached pinned GitHub file/directory metadata only; separate from the 46 complete-content hash checks and from S/D/P review or runtime qualification.
